quarterly_data.signal: As of August 2, 2026 Photronics had outstanding capital commitments of approximately $215.3 million and accrued liabilities for capital equipment purchases of approximately $48.9 million, and expects to fund $257.3 million of its $264.2 million committed and recognized capex obligations over the next twelve months. Year-to-date capital expenditure payments were $130.4 million in the nine months ended August 2, 2026 versus $120.6 million a year earlier; fiscal 2026 capex is estimated mainly in Asia and the U.S.
quarterly_data.figure: capital commitments ~$215.3 million (as of Aug 2, 2026); $257.3 million of $264.2 million to be funded over the next twelve months; YTD capex payments $130.4 million vs $120.6 million
